summary: Bug Fix Verified: Wizard setup now correctly displays existing divisions and conference alignment. Backend: 9/9 tests PASS. Frontend: All UI elements verified for both Stat Chasers Roto (2 divisions, 1 conference) and Frozen Dynasty (4 divisions, 2 conferences).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend teams.py: TeamResponse model now includes 'division' and 'conference' fields (lines 129-130)
Backend teams.py: team_to_response() function correctly extracts division/conference from team document (lines 180-181)
Backend leagues.py: GET /leagues/{id}/divisions endpoint returns full structure including team assignments, conferences, and division_conference_map (lines 747-787)
Frontend SetupWizard.jsx: Division hydration block now fetches /divisions endpoint (divR) alongside teams (line 183)
Frontend SetupWizard.jsx: Uses divData.divisions to populate divisionList, conferenceList, divisionToConference, and divisionAssignments (lines 245-286)
Frontend SetupWizard.jsx: Falls back to team-level fields from /teams response for backward compatibility (lines 271-280)
seed_data_creation: Used existing leagues: 'Stat Chasers Roto' (69e46af167999bfb85c39629), 'Frozen Dynasty' (69e46af167999bfb85c3962a)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Division/conference wizard hydration bug is fixed. The wizard now correctly loads existing divisions, conferences, division-conference mappings, and team assignments from the /api/leagues/{id}/divisions endpoint. Both 2-division (Stat Chasers Roto) and 4-division (Frozen Dynasty) configurations verified working.

GET /api/teams?league_id={id}.division_field: Returns division field for each team (previously missing/null)
GET /api/teams?league_id={id}.conference_field: Returns conference field for each team (previously missing/null)
GET /api/teams?league_id={id}.stat_chasers_roto: 14 teams, all have division (North/South) and conference (Test)
GET /api/teams?league_id={id}.frozen_dynasty: 16 teams, all have division (Atlantic/Metropolitan/Central/Pacific) and conference (Eastern/Western)

GET /api/leagues/{id}/divisions.divisions_array: Returns full division structure with team assignments
GET /api/leagues/{id}/divisions.team_ids_and_teams: Returns both team_ids array and teams array with id/name/abbr
GET /api/leagues/{id}/divisions.unassigned_teams: Returns list of teams not assigned to any division
GET /api/leagues/{id}/divisions.structure_locked: Returns whether the structure is locked

stat_chasers_roto.team_assignments: 7 teams in North, 7 teams in South, 0 unassigned
stat_chasers_roto.team_dropdowns: Each team shows correct Division and Conference in table

frozen_dynasty.team_dropdowns: Each team shows correct Division and Conference in table

schedule_step.playoffs_enabled_toggle: Correctly shows ON state matching league's playoffs_enabled setting

root_cause_analysis.bug_description: Wizard setup doesn't see existing divisions and conference alignment that has already been set by the league
root_cause: TeamResponse model in teams.py didn't include division/conference fields even though they were stored in MongoDB
team_to_response() function didn't extract division/conference from the team document
SetupWizard.jsx only read from team objects and never fetched the /divisions endpoint
fix_applied: Added division: Optional[str] = None and conference: Optional[str] = None to TeamResponse model
Added division=team.get('division') and conference=team.get('conference') to team_to_response()
Updated SetupWizard.jsx to fetch /api/leagues/{id}/divisions as the primary hydration source
Added fallback to team-level fields for backward compatibility
root_cause_analysis.verification: Both Stat Chasers Roto (2 divisions, 1 conference) and Frozen Dynasty (4 divisions, 2 conferences) now correctly display all previously configured settings in the wizard
